# TPC-DS-OBT Q28

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B1_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B1_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B1_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B1, (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B2_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B2_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B2_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 6 AND 10 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B2, (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B3_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B3_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B3_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 11 AND 15 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B3, (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B4_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B4_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B4_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 16 AND 20 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B4, (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B5_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B5_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B5_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 25 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B5, (SELECT AVG(obt.list_price) AS B6_LP, COUNT(obt.list_price) AS B6_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT obt.list_price) AS B6_CNTD FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.quantity BETWEEN 26 AND 30 AND (obt.list_price BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 10 OR obt.coupon_amt BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 1000 OR obt.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 0 AND 0 + 20)) AND channel = 'store') AS B6 LIMIT 100
```
